item.title: Caleb Williams set to participate in NBA All-Star Weekend
item.description: Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams is set to compete in the celebrity 3-point shooting contest during NBA All-Star Weekend 2026 in Los Angeles, taking advice from his head coach to take some time away from football to unwind.
